Theme

Body, health & movement

castrate verb

also geld, neuter (an animal), emasculate

classical

Plaut. Merc. 272: ego illunc hircum castrārī volō
Varr. RR 2.2.18: agnum (Lewis & Short)

castrō, castrāre, castrāvī, castrātum

verb, first conjugation

castrate, geld (a man or an animal)

Also of pruning plants and of straining wine (Pliny).

Examples

  • Profectō ego illunc hircum castrārī volō, rūrī quī vōbīs exhibet negōtium.

    I really do want that he-goat castrated, the one that gives you trouble on the farm.Plaut. Merc. 272–273

See also eunuch, testicle.

SourcesLewis & Short: castro

Plautus, Mercator 272–273.
